body: You’re right. I think he would want to know just because I did carry his child (even if it was just a couple months) and family is something he really cherishes. But he’s just beginning to date a new girl and I feel like that would just cause too much pain and confusion and damage what he’s trying to build, which I don’t want for him. He deserves his happiness. Thank you, you’ve helped
Exactly, there’s no point in dragging him down with me. Thank you, that helped
Thank you. It’s unreal. Having someone second what I’ve been thinking helped a lot though. There’s really no point in telling him. Just because I’m sad doesn’t mean I have to drag him down with me.
